children: Galaxy Gaming entered into a Second Amendment to its Credit Agreement with BMO Bank to increase capital spending flexibility and refine covenant calculations. The amendment raises the annual capital expenditure cap to no more than 10% of the prior year's net revenue and approves a one-time EBITDA addback of $505,361 solely for ratio compliance purposes. Management expects these changes to enhance financial flexibility while supporting ongoing compliance.
